en.headline: 2 own commits plus 22 automated commits; 2 issues touched
en.summary: **2 own commits** were made, plus 22 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/myBlog`, the author added a screenshot showing the OpenChamber session retention hint. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, documentation was updated with the on-disk locations for the VS Code harness and for disabling AI features, and the Profile conclusion was corrected. On `openchamber/openchamber`, issue #5680, “[Bug] Session retention hint still describes the old "Only archived sessions" checkbox”, was opened and received one comment from `openchamber-bot[bot]`, whose analysis confirmed the reported symptom and traced the cause. On `anomalyco/opencode`, the author commented on issue #55772, “[FEATURE]: Windows desktop ships the CLI but there is no way to run it”, which has two comments in total. No pull requests, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded.
